verdict.rationale: Anthropic's transparency hub links a published system card PDF for Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 and summarizes safety testing across three risk areas, so a published system card exists. The evidence does not show what the card covers beyond safety testing, and it is unclear whether those models are the current flagship, since the API changelog points to Opus 5.5. missing for 10: evidence that the card covers capabilities, training approach, full evaluation results, and intended use; confirmation it applies to the current flagship model; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model

citations.quote: the transparency hub links the "Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card" PDF and summarizes testing across "three critical risk areas" including malicious computer use
